 Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the testing procedures 
P1, which must be performed on an annually 
bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. 
Islam Abd Alla, tested by eng. Islam Abd Alla, revised by 
EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd El Qader El Nagar, 
accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Azab, 
and approved by eng. Fawzy sobhy Ismail 
Head Sector of Abu Sultan PS.
This document 
accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general 
director and MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed 
Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general director 
and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the equipment which its protection relay under test
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Isolate the equipment which its protection relay under test
Tools and Equipment
Current injection 
 device with timer.
Test plug, test leads
Test cabinet.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the operation of the auxiliary and 
 instantaneous over current unit manually to see that they operate smoothly 
 with out noticeable friction or binds .
Check the contact gap and wipe which 
 should agree with values given under section on servicing .
The relay have three winding (W1.W2.W3).
Inject the current gradually for each 
 winding.
Record the value of the tripping current 
 for each winding.
Compare the result with the reference 
 value.
Repeat the test for each phase.
Return Relay into Service
Return the relay 
 to the panel.
Withdraw the test plug 
 handle from the relay.
Return all connections to the normal position as before 
 the test.
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
Close the work permit.
